text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, use some common sense~! When it comes to racing, it's all about endurance, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...'C-Common sense'!? Did you really just utter those words!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, we were talking about wanting to do some extra training...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Let's have Trainer-san decide! 'Which of these three sounds best to you?!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Extra training... There's certainly still time left. It could be beneficial for <chrname> as well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The 'Outer Perimeter', obviously! I will conquer... this vast, boundless ocean! No treasure map needed! Objective: pure stamina!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No way, the 'Speed King Championship' is way better! Sparks fly in a head-to-head race, getting our fighting spirits blazing... and we'll be super pumped like WOOOOAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I think 'All-You-Can-Eat Training' would be wonderful! Eating well after exercising is super important! I believe it's a splendid form of training!
choice_data_list: Running the outer perimeter sounds like great stamina work.
Running the outer perimeter sounds like great stamina work.
...It offers some rest, so maybe all-you-can-eat?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:

Eating well after exercising is super important!
I believe it's a splendid form of training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I agree with that principle. I do agree, but... the one proposing it exists far outside the boundaries of common sense.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-It'll be okay! She has such a serious look on her face... Maybe that's the secret to Gold Ship-san's strength...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um, where are we?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: They say a Cryptid lives on this mountain. Let's bag it and make a quick fortune!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good grief, ENOUGH ALREADY--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though running the perimeter turned into a mountain trek... it still served as useful training reference.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
YAAAAY!! Woohoo, woohoo~~~!!
Alright, let's decide the distance with rock-paper-scissors!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...With this many people, a majority vote makes more sense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the impromptu race unfolded into a breathtaking, neck-and-neck battle—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, my spirit's really blazing, and my whole body feels so warm...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Right, right?! Totally blazing~~!! Let's do the Derby distance next!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For as long as time permitted, they continued racing under various requested conditions.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I'm so glad I saved up those all-you-can-eat sweets coupons~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, your coupon booklet really came in handy, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I-It cannot be helped, desu wa.
It would be improper to turn down such goodwill.

text_block_list.name: Spe & McQueen
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After thoroughly unwinding, their bonds grew even deeper!
